_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_logs" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "height_cm" REAL NULL, "fat_percentage" REAL NULL, "water_ml_raw" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "water_ml_credit" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "creatine_g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "mental_state" TEXT NULL, "body_feeling" TEXT NULL, "braces_used" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "brace_comfort" INTEGER NULL, "steps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_rest_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_rest_day" IN (0, 1)), "is_flare_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_flare_day" IN (0, 1)), "sleep_hours" REAL NULL, "sleep_quality" TEXT NULL, "sleep_heart_rate_min" INTEGER NULL, "sleep_heart_rate_max" INTEGER NULL, "resting_heart_rate" INTEGER NULL, "hrv_ms" REAL NULL, "steps_source" TEXT NULL, "sleep_source" TEXT NULL, "heart_source" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activities" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "activity_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_min" INTEGER NOT NULL, "extra_weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "mental_state" TEXT NULL, "body_feeling" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "healthkit_uuid" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "mets_avg" REAL NULL, "active_energy_kcal" REAL NULL, "heart_rate_min_bpm" INTEGER NULL, "heart_rate_max_bpm" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "calisthenics" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise" TEXT NOT NULL, "progression" TEXT NOT NULL, "sets" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "set_values" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'reps', "comfort_score" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "mental_state" TEXT NULL, "body_feeling" TEXT NULL, "contraction_mode" TEXT NULL, "heart_rate_min_bpm" INTEGER NULL, "heart_rate_max_bpm" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "therapies" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "therapy_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_min" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mental_state" TEXT NULL, "body_feeling" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "liquid_logs" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "drink_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "custom_drink_label" TEXT NULL, "amount_ml_raw" INTEGER NOT NULL, "hydration_ml_credit" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weather_cache" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lon" REAL NOT NULL, "temp_c" REAL NULL, "humidity_pct" REAL NULL, "pressure_hpa" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date", "lat", "lon"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "soreness_checks" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "onset" TEXT NOT NULL, "spread" TEXT NOT NULL, "trend" TEXT NOT NULL, "verdict" TEXT NOT NULL, "verdict_label" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "checkins" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "mental_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "body_feeling" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "injuries" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date_started" TEXT NOT NULL, "zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "resolved_at" TEXT NULL, "still_painful" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("still_painful" IN (0, 1)), "compared_to_usual" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "training_plans" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "weeks" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 12, "weekly_ceiling_min" INTEGER NULL, "floor_note" TEXT NULL, "current_phase_id" TEXT NULL, "test_weeks" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_phases" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal" TEXT NULL, "effort" TEXT NULL, "cardio" TEXT NULL, "gate" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_sessions" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekday" INTEGER NULL, "duration_min" INTEGER NULL, "low_day_note" TEXT NULL, "is_cardio" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_cardio" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_exercises" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "cue" TEXT NULL, "current_step_id" TEXT NULL, "step_changed_on" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_steps" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "dose" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'reps', "needs_clearance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("needs_clearance" IN (0, 1)), "cleared_on" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_session_logs" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_min" INTEGER NULL, "next_morning" TEXT NULL, "activity_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_set_logs" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_log_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "step_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "set_values" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'reps', "pain" INTEGER NULL, "sharp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sharp" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_checkins" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "week_start" TEXT NOT NULL, "sessions_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sessions_planned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "had_pem" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("had_pem" IN (0, 1)), "pem_cause" TEXT NULL, "joints_ok" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("joints_ok" IN (0, 1)), "protein_days" INTEGER NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "win" TEXT NULL, "fear_step" TEXT NULL, "decision" TEXT NOT NULL, "ceiling_before" INTEGER NULL, "ceiling_after" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_tests" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_test_results" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "test_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fear_items" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "fear" INTEGER NOT NULL, "initial_fear" INTEGER NOT NULL, "settled_on" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exposure_logs" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fear_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempt" TEXT NULL, "prediction" TEXT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NULL, "fear_before" INTEGER NULL, "fear_after" INTEGER NULL, "nothing_bad" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("nothing_bad" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stand_tests" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "baseline_position" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lying', "baseline_hr" INTEGER NULL, "baseline_sys" INTEGER NULL, "baseline_dia" INTEGER NULL, "hr1" INTEGER NULL, "sys1" INTEGER NULL, "dia1" INTEGER NULL, "hr3" INTEGER NULL, "sys3" INTEGER NULL, "dia3" INTEGER NULL, "hr10" INTEGER NULL, "sys10" INTEGER NULL, "dia10" INTEGER NULL, "symptoms" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "stopped_early" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("stopped_early" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sweat_logs" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "kinds" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "blood_pressure_readings" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "taken_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "systolic" INTEGER NOT NULL, "diastolic" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pulse" INTEGER NULL, "position" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sitting', "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
